---

## The job

Issue #410 (person-owned, do not close, no version bump, no release, no `.github/**` hand-edits): the system posts too many comments on issue threads; consolidate with **no behavioural degradation whatsoever**. The human (yuma-seno) decided on 2026-10-29 that measures **A–D** ship in one PR, one commit per measure; **E (footer `<details>` folding)** and **F (minimize)** are out of scope. Report per measure in Japanese as 何を変えたか / 何を確認したか / 残るリスク, marking anything not measured live as 未実測.

Hard conditions: A keeps the marker `llm-context=include`; A's restore is idempotent (no leftover took tag); B's one-comment-two-roles holds (restart run reads the trigger, no double dispatch); C's read-before-edit race loses only a count; D loses no limit information when no result comment exists and `manage_dispatch_loop.ts` chain counting is unchanged. If any measure risks degradation, do not implement it — report why with file:line.

## Where I am

The run that produced this is **post-merge re-entry** on issue #410: PR #412 merged into `main` (merge commit `fc03c34`, "Merge pull request #412 from yuma-seno/atomaton/issue-410"). Local work tree is on branch `main`, clean, in sync with `origin/main`. All five feature commits are ancestors of `fc03c34` (verified by inspecting the merge's content).

The job now is the role contract's post-merge outcome: judge what merged against what the issue asked for, then call `request_close_issue` if the criteria are met — **but** the issue is person-owned and the human explicitly said not to close it. Earlier runs (and the decision comment) said レポートを最終メッセージとして投稿し、issue は閉じない. So: verify on the merged head, report, and end with `/atomaton` (never both a slash line and an @mention; at most one call).

## Verification already done on the merged head (`fc03c34`)

- A present: `src/entrypoints/machinery/claim_turn.ts:138` (`claimOnMarkerBody`); the same-run-id branch now only backs off — `src/entrypoints/machinery/claim_turn.ts:217` ("run backs off and leaves the line alone, whoever wrote it"); `withoutClaimLine` gone (grep count 0). Fixed by commit `e68373b` in response to review finding 1.
- A include condition pinned by `src/entrypoints/machinery/claim_turn.test.ts:127`; re-run case pinned at `claim_turn.test.ts:209`.
- B: `src/adapters/actions/dispatch-targets.ts:154` and `:240` both write `llm-context=include` + `DISPATCH_TAG.write(agent)`; `RunnerDispatch.markerCommentId` at `src/adapters/actions/dispatch.ts:173`, used at `:679`. Two-role contract test `src/entrypoints/machinery/dispatch_post_merge.test.ts:76` with `wasLaunched(entry, readers)` at `:98`.
- C: `src/adapters/github/sub-issue-report.ts:191` (`mergeProgressIntoReport`), called from `src/app/aggregation.ts:267`; fallback POST at `aggregation.ts:270` still carries `SUB_RESULT_TAG`; progress line from `subIssueProgressLine` (`aggregation.ts:260`); `progress?: boolean` at `aggregation.ts:108`. Test `src/adapters/github/sub-issue-report.test.ts:315` and CLI test in `aggregate_sub_issues.test.ts`.
- D: `spentOn` in `src/entrypoints/machinery/post_result_comment.ts:571/:651/:689`; `notified=` output at `post_result_comment.ts:1060`; workflow gate `src/workflows/atomaton-runner.wac.ts:2360` (`... && steps.post-result.outputs.notified != 'true'`) with outputs `["comment_id","notified"]` at `:1351`; `notify_limit_reached.ts` no longer carries the tally (`notify_limit_reached.ts:23`), pinned by `notify_limit_reached.test.ts:52`. Fixed by `e68373b` in response to review finding 2.
- `package.json` `"version"` still `0.21.51` on main — untouched.
- `bun run typecheck` clean on the merged tree.
- `bun test`: first run on the merged tree gave 2177 tests / 79 fail + 4 errors in workflow-generation contract tests — **because `dist/**` had not been built in this fresh checkout**. After `bun run synth` (`bun run src/synth-workflows.ts && bun run src/build-dist.ts`): **2184 pass / 6 skip / 0 fail**. `bun run synth` left the work tree clean (generated output is gitignored). This must not be reported as a regression.
- `.github/atomaton-runtime/scripts/claim_turn.ts` in-tree is the **pre-1.0 bundle** of the old `claim_turn` (it still has `claimCommentBody`/`raceOutcome`, and `claimOnMarkerBody` count 0). That is the release pipeline's stale copy, not a defect of this PR; it refreshes on the next release (`.github/atomaton-release.json`, `bun run synth`, self-deploy workflow). Worth one sentence at most; do not try to fix it here.

## Still open / unmeasured

- **未実測 throughout**: real GitHub PATCH behaviour (A's claim append, C's progress append), the real re-run/no-double-dispatch behaviour, and D's `notified` output with the notice actually skipping — all verified only against fake `gh`, pure readers, and the synthesized workflow, plus the green check runs GitHub reported. `bun run test:e2e` on the merged tree: 5 pass / 6 skip (skips need a real binary/credentials).
- For the final message, if e2e has not been re-run on the merged head, either run it or state that it was run before the merge (it was: 5 pass / 6 skip).
- Known cosmetic residual: PR #412's body still describes A as "復元 PATCH (`withoutClaimLine`)" and D's notice section loosely; `engineer` had no tool to edit a PR body. Correct text lives in commit `e68373b`'s message. Say this once, briefly.

## Rules that still apply

- `commit_and_push` / `sync_branch` / `merge_base_into_branch` only for branch work; never create/switch/reset/rebase/commit/push via shell. Do not re-do any of the above code changes — they are merged.
- Do not close issue #410 by a call that would contradict the human's instruction; `/atomaton` is the correct hand-off, with the report above it.
- Closing message: conclusion first, no opening/closing pleasantries, at most 5 anchored items in "how I know" (fold evidence), name unmeasured things explicitly, "what happens next" last.
- Report the state, not the doing: which criteria are met on `main`, which are unmeasured-live, and that the issue is left for the human per their instruction.
